subject: Activation request: GPU safety-net for late-stage Pivotal AI POC
msg_1_to: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
msg_1_subject: Activation request: GPU safety-net for late-stage Pivotal AI POC
msg_1_body:
Team,

Pivotal AI (PIV-2043) is moving to a late-stage POC and is asking for a short runway guarantee while they finalize procurement. They want the environment live for a demo window starting the week of May 5.

Request:
- Place a provisional "soft" hold for 8 A100-equivalent GPUs (or nearest equivalent GPU profile) in us-west-2 for a 3-week window (target start 2025-05-05).
- Confirm fallback region (us-west-1 / us-east-1) if capacity pressure appears.
- Provide a quick cost delta for reserved hold vs on-demand for the 3-week window.

I attached a lightweight runbook (capacity_runbook.xlsx) with their expected POC cadence and the short-term SLA ask. This is time-sensitive — procurement indicated they will have an executed SOW within ~10 days but want the staging environment ready earlier.

Please flag any operational blockers. If we can do a soft hold with an automatic release if PO isn't received by 2025-05-12, that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Account Lead, Strategic Deals
Redwood Inference
msg_2_to: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
msg_2_subject: Re: Activation request: GPU safety-net for late-stage Pivotal AI POC
msg_2_body:
Grace / all —

I can stand this up as a provisional soft hold and will open an internal capacity ticket. Notes so far:
- Soft hold ticket: CH-9812 (provisional).
- Target resources: 8x A100-equivalent (slotting for 8x 80GB slices).
- Ops will validate node mapping and thermal headroom by EOD tomorrow.

I'll loop infrastructure and capacity planning to confirm exact node types and fallback region. Expect a follow-up from Karthik with confirmation and an ETA for allocation.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Capacity Planning
Redwood Inference
msg_3_cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
msg_3_body:
Lisa —

Thanks for moving quickly. To validate the sizing and avoid surprises during the demo window, can you confirm the following by EOD tomorrow: 
- Model family and parameter count (if public is fine, fine to say ‘~6B’ or similar).
- Expected sustained QPS (for the demo) and concurrent sessions.
- Typical input/output token lengths and any long-context requirements.

Attached is a draft SOW (pivotal_sow_v1.pdf) for your review; we can iterate on numbers after you share the expected peak loads.

We'd like to confirm the provisional hold doesn't restrict your ability to run early tests — the hold is intended to guarantee runway but we will allow staged access.

Best,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
(Referenced attachment: pivotal_sow_v1.pdf)
msg_4_subject: Re: Pivotal POC kickoff & sizing questions
msg_4_body:
Monica / Grace —

Thanks — quick answers below:
- Model: proprietary decoder-only model (roughly 6B parameters).
- Demo expected peak traffic: ~600 QPS with bursts up to ~900 QPS for short intervals. Concurrent sessions: ~120.
- Avg input length: 80 tokens; avg response: 45 tokens. No long-context beyond 2k tokens for the POC.

Procurement has shared a signed intent form and asked us to coordinate environment readiness. I've uploaded the SOW to DocuSign and pinged procurement to finish the PO — link: https://www.docusign.com/s/pivotal-sow-2025

Would prefer target date of 2025-05-06 for the first demo. Please let me know if that is feasible and whether we should expect any cadence restrictions while the hold is active.

—Lisa
Lisa Carter
VP Product, Pivotal AI
msg_5_to: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
msg_5_subject: Re: Activation request: GPU safety-net for late-stage Pivotal AI POC — provisional hold confirmed
msg_5_body:
Grace / team —

Confirmed: CH-9812 created and provisional soft hold placed. Summary: 
- Resources reserved: 8x A100-equivalent GPUs in us-west-2 (rack-aware placement).
- Hold window: 2025-05-05 through 2025-05-26 (3 weeks). Auto-release set for 2025-05-12 if no PO/DocuSign completion; can extend with approval.
- Fallback: automatic relocation policy to us-east-1 if us-west-2 utilization exceeds 85% during the window; we will notify 48 hours in advance.
- Cost delta (est.): ~$21,600 incremental for the 3-week reserved soft hold vs strictly on-demand pinning during burst periods. Full breakdown attached (capacity_estimate_pivotal.pdf).
- Ops notes: staging access will be allowed for Pivotal test accounts; production-only routing will remain gated until SOW is fully executed.

Action items: 
- Grace: please confirm you want us to proceed with the auto-release on 2025-05-12 if PO not complete.
- Monica: use the sizing numbers Lisa provided to finalize the node mapping in the runbook.
- Ben: please coordinate the thermal headroom validation tomorrow morning as promised.

I'll post the runbook link and the ticket in the capacity channel.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Dedicated Capacity Operations
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: capacity_estimate_pivotal.pdf)
